title: Don’t Forget—Catch Us at ASHRM!
summary: Don't forget to say hi at the American Society for Health Care Risk Management's Annual conference!
body_markdown:
The American Society for Health Care Risk Management (ASHRM) is hosting its[Annual Conference](https://www.ashrm.org/annual-conference)


October 4-6, 2026, in Phoenix, Arizona, at the Phoenix Convention Center.


The Annual Conference is an opportunity to create awareness, improve sentiment among healthcare risk managers, and network with agency partners and prospects.


If you’re attending the conference, check your attendee bag for a ProAssurance item and bring it to our booth for the match. There you’ll also have the opportunity to adopt a baby cactus from our Cacti Adoption Center!


For a full breakdown of who you can see from ProAssurance, check out our “[Mark the Calendar for ASHRM 2026](https://proassurance.com/news/mark-the-calendar-for-ashrm-2026)


” article.
